source: Starter set of common Reel formats and collage layouts. Not yet checked against what is trending this week.

templates.name: Fast cuts on the beat
templates.about: 16 photos, hard cuts every 0.4 seconds. Pair with any upbeat trending audio.

templates.name: Slow build, then burst
templates.about: Three slow shots to set the scene, then 14 rapid ones. Works with audio that has a drop.

templates.name: Slow zoom highlights
templates.about: 7 of the best shots, 2.2 seconds each with a slow zoom. The whole photo stays visible on a blurred backdrop.

templates.name: Top 5, best last
templates.about: Five shots, 2.4 seconds each, building to the best one. Add the 5 to 1 numbers yourself in Edits.

templates.name: Stop-motion sequence
templates.about: One burst of action played as a flip-book and looped three times. Uses a sequence, not single shots.

templates.name: 30-second recap
templates.about: 20 photos, 1.5 seconds each with a gentle zoom. A whole event in half a minute.

templates.name: Speed ramp
templates.about: 18 photos that start slow and get faster and faster. Good with audio that builds.

templates.name: Heartbeat
templates.about: 16 photos in a long-short, long-short rhythm. Works with a steady two-beat track.

templates.name: Three hero shots
templates.about: Three photos, 3.5 seconds each with a strong slow zoom, best one last. For a win or an award.

templates.name: Roster roll
templates.about: 12 photos, 0.8 seconds each. Made for portraits or one shot per player.

templates.name: Story of the day
templates.about: 10 photos, 3 seconds each, whole photo on a blurred backdrop. Calm pace for a recap with a voice-over.

collages.name: Two side by side
collages.about: Two tall photos next to each other.

collages.name: Three in a row
collages.about: Three tall strips. Good for a serve, set, hit sequence.

collages.name: One big, two small
collages.about: The first photo large on the left, two stacked on the right.

collages.name: One big, three below
collages.about: The first photo large across the top, three in a row underneath.

collages.name: Grid of nine
collages.about: Three by three. A team wall or a full tournament day.

collages.name: One in the middle, four around
collages.about: The first photo in a wide band across the middle, two above and two below.

collages.name: Grid of four, no borders
collages.about: Two by two with the photos touching.

collages.name: One big, two small, black borders
collages.about: The same as One big, two small, on black.
